QuestInfo.name: Judgment of the Fallen
QuestInfo.1: Defeat the corrupted guards and monk trainees who are guarding the way to Arkarium's Altar.
QuestInfo.2: You cleared the path of enemies and reached the entrance to the Altar.

0.0: You're on your own from here out. You really outclassed me! I'll just hide so I don't get in the way.

yes.0: The only way to Arkarium's Altar is through all those corrupted guards and monk trainees.

no.0: Do you have a better idea? I'm not really the idea type.

1.0: Did you beat up all those corrupted guards and monk trainees?

yes.0: I think this is the end! Come talk to me again if you feel like it.

mob.0: Take down 100 #o9300301#s and 100 #o9300302#s. You'll never make it to Arkarium if you leave them wandering around!
